unresolved: Triple-division homology is a library-level hypothesis, not a source conclusion: no book places material, decoration and use in one causal chain; the claim that pottery repositioned itself (daily use / bronze-emulation / burial) after bronze took over the ritual-vessel role, and that bai-tao therefore disappeared, is marked as an explanatory frame

Bai-tao (white pottery) disappearance: Tian Zibing records only 'after the Shang, this product is no longer found', plus a reported conjecture that northern potters were imitating southern hard pottery; neither the disappearance nor the conjecture is verified by any of the six books

Duplicate entries: terms/bai-tao (white pottery, Tian Zibing) and terms/shangdai-baitao (Shang white pottery, Xia Yanjing + Zhao Nong) denote the same object; only the former is mounted, so the evidence for bai-tao remains incomplete (one source, no Zhengzhou kiln material, no Zhao Nong carved white pottery description)

Caihui-tao (painted pottery) process definition is inverted across the six books: Tian Zibing and Gao Feng paint on the fired body, Xia Yanjing (both editions) paints the raw body and then fires - the latter is the caicao (painted Neolithic pottery) process. Uses agree across all four (mainly burial mingqi), which is why this batch classifies by use; but under the Xia account caihui-tao and caicao become indistinguishable in process

Anwen-tao (dark-pattern pottery): two spellings of the alias coexist (yahua-tao / yanhua-tao); centre of production given as 'the Central Plains' in one book and 'centred on Henan' in another; tool form, and the process relation to polished and painted pottery, are not given in any book

Geometric stamped hard pottery: three periods coexist (Spring and Autumn / Warring States / Shang-Western Zhou); two forming methods (coil-built / coil-ring stacked); the geometric patterns are explained once as decoration and once as a by-product of forming

Mingqi (burial models): no book gives the sumptuary rules or a material classification, so this batch can say what was buried but not who was entitled to what; the proportional relation between model and real object is stated only as 'reduced to scale', with no ratio data

Qin terracotta army: kiln site not found ('the kiln site is still being sought'); 7,000-odd versus c. 8,000-odd pieces; 'life-size' coexists with a height range of 1.75-1.85 m and a maximum of 1.98 m without explaining the distribution; 'fire then join' and 'join then fire' coexist without conditions, adhesive, or yield; mould material, module count, fine-clay layer thickness, firing temperature and pigment composition are all missing

Model mingqi scale data is almost entirely absent: the painted granary tower at 78.2 cm is the only absolute dimension; the storyteller figurine, the well model and the green-glazed tower have none; the well model rests on a single caption (confidence: low) with no well-frame or pulley construction

Hunping (urn): the alias 'grain jar' cannot establish a storage function - the source itself lists it alongside huntng and shenting; no height, belly diameter, tomb, kiln or date; the stacking layers and glaze colour are unverified

Jianxing-hu (cocoon jar): use not recorded; listed among Qin pottery types alongside ding, gui, yan, dou, yu, pen, guan, bo, weng, fu, zao and suantou-ping; it cannot be inferred from the name or the cocoon shape to be either mingqi or a wine vessel

Continuity between Neolithic functional pottery (gui, zeng, xun) and the Shang-Zhou-Han triple division is not narrated in any book; if a functional-classification Topic is later created, the boundary between 'function determines form' and 'use determines category' must be drawn against B.5.3
notes: 本批新建 1 个 Topic（B.5.3 陶器的三重分化），挂载 15 个 KU，不新增 Theme。结构设计的三项判断：其一，Topic 名与原定方案不同——h25 manifest 登记的是「B.5.3 商周秦汉陶器与明器」，读完 15 条候选后，材料实际在回答「三重分化是否同源」，故改题并按材质（三把尺子）、装饰（三档可见性）、用途（明器尺度两极）三层组织。其二，三把材质尺子不能排成演化线：灰陶按烧成气氛（还原焰，占商代出土陶器九成以上）、白陶按原料（高岭土，仿青铜纹饰，商以后不复发现）、硬陶按火度（高温，胎骨坚致），三者不是同一分类系统的三个值。其三，明器内部有尺度两极：兵马俑等身写实（7000 余件、1.75—1.85 米）与仓楼、井、绿釉陶楼缩小模型（仓楼 78.2 厘米）对应被替代对象不同（人／物），不是工艺水平高低。四项边界处置：彩绘陶按用途定义而非工序定义（四册工序相反、用途一致），故不与彩陶并置；史前功能陶器留 B.5.1／B.5.2；建筑用陶与画像砖留后续 Topic；低温釉陶工艺归 B.5.4。白陶与商代白陶为同一对象的两个条目，本批只挂前者并登记 potential_duplicate。本批不 commit、不 push。
